question: Can the participant's EEG separate a likely category-average response from an image-specific deviation when no target-class support EEG or photograph is supplied?
data: Use only the official-repeat study's generic training recordings. Keep its 884 fitting objects, 64 temperature/angle calibration objects and 64 evaluation objects, ten photos per object. These generic splits have appeared in other development studies. No official test image or EEG is needed for this screening step.
method: Use the frozen rank-32 EEG/text-synthesized visual centroid CCA score across all 1854 object names. Standardize each row and softmax. On the calibration objects choose the posterior temperature from 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 by true-name negative log likelihood. Apply the same text kernel ridge with leave-one-out correction at fitted names to synthesize both visual and EEG class means for all names. Posterior weights average both tables. Subtract the posterior-expected class EEG from the measured query. A ridge fitted only to within-class deviations on the 884 fitting objects predicts the photo residual in native H14 space. Add the residual to the posterior visual mean. Calibrate the angle around the predicted class mean with the ratio of median true to median predicted angle on the 64 calibration objects and cap at the 95th percentile true angle.
controls: Include the original native readout, its calibrated global-angle version, posterior visual mean alone, the new posterior-plus-residual, and a diagnostic swap of EEG residuals across the ten pictures within each evaluation class. The matched posterior stays fixed in the swap. Classification truth only enters calibration, scoring and this control.
outcomes: Primary object score is H14 cosine naming among the 64 held-out objects from their other nine photos, excluding the query's photo ordinal from every class. Also report H14 same-object exact top1 and mean wins against nine distractors, full 640-photo retrieval, continuous cosine. Bootstrap 64 complete objects, paired, 10000 draws, seed 260548. Advance to the official image generator only if object-name point estimate is no worse than the global-angle comparator, paired win rate versus same-class photo distractors has a strictly positive lower 95% bound against global angle, and matched beats its swapped residual.
